'''Voon Massa''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]]. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Admiral Massa was placed at the command of the [[New Republic Fourth Fleet|Fourth Fleet]]. Tasked to reconquer the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], the Admiral was victorious at [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]], [[Milagro/Legends|Milagro]], and [[Spirana/Legends|Spirana]]. Voon Massa was killed at the [[Battle of Denon (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Denon]], but the Fourth Fleet's decisive victory allowed the New Republic to penetrate the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].
